title_en: The Light at the End of the Corridor
note_en: 哪怕 "even if, even though" introduces a concession, and the main clause usually has 也: 哪怕 A，也 B "even if A, still B." In the text: 哪怕有了这些案例，陈默的同事们也没人敢去申请加班费 "even with these cases on record, none of Chen Mo's coworkers dared to claim overtime pay"; 哪怕他已经走进了电梯，办公室里也还是安静了好一会儿 "even after he had stepped into the elevator, the office stayed quiet for a good while." The pattern stresses that the result doesn't change, whatever the condition.
